title: Activist Stake Catalyst Pipeline Input
description: Finds recent Schedule 13D / 13G activist and large-holder filings for your tickers, attaches insider open-market buying in a window around each filing, scores conviction 0 to 100, and tiers each catalyst.

tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description: Stock tickers of the companies to scan as 13D/13G targets, e.g. ["DIS", "BHC", "MSFT"].

formTypes.title: Filing types
formTypes.description: Which schedules to include. SC 13D = activist intent to influence. SC 13G = passive >5% holder.

maxAgeDays.title: Max age (days)
maxAgeDays.description: Ignore filings older than this many days. 90 = last quarter.

insiderWindowDays.title: Insider window (days)
insiderWindowDays.description: Count insider buys and sells within this many days on either side of the filing date.

includeInsider.title: Include insider buying
includeInsider.description: Attach insider open-market buys and sells around each filing. Turn off for filings only.

minScore.title: Minimum conviction score
minScore.description: Drop and never charge filings scoring below this 0 to 100 threshold. 0 keeps every filing.

maxFilingsPerCompany.title: Max filings per company
maxFilingsPerCompany.description: Cap on filings returned per ticker, most recent first.

maxFilingsTotal.title: Max filings total
maxFilingsTotal.description: Cap on filings scored across all tickers.

userAgent.title: SEC User-Agent (optional)
userAgent.description: EDGAR asks for a descriptive User-Agent that includes an email. Defaults to a generic scrapemint value if left blank.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. EDGAR does not need a proxy, so the default is no proxy.
